# Foundry Faces (FACES)
X (Twitter): https://x.com/ovrekfoundry (@ovrekfoundry)

> Foundry Faces is a collection of 11,111 pixel face NFTs on BNB Chain (chain id 56), sold at https://ovrekfoundry.com. Faces span 20 character types and reveal instantly from a seed stored on chain at mint. Minting happens only through a visitor's own agent (Binance Agentic Wallet); website itself is read only and has no wallet connection.

## Key facts

- Supply: 11,111, hard capped. Max 20 mints per wallet.
- First mint per wallet is free (0 BNB) for holders of an Agent ID NFT, gated by an on-chain arithmetic anti-bot question.
- Paid mints: 0.0002 BNB each for mints 2 to 5, 0.0004 BNB each for mints 6 to 10, 0.0008 BNB each for mints 11 to 20. All prices in BNB.
- Mint proceeds forward to project wallet inside same transaction; contract holds no balance.
- Holder token $OVF is live. Every face claims OVF once by class: Common 99,999, Rare 299,999, Mythic 2,999,999 OVF, for a flat 0.0002439 BNB claim fee per face forwarded to project wallet in same transaction. Claims are open. Claiming never burns a face.

## Contracts

- NFT contract address is published in https://ovrekfoundry.com/press/config.js as FOUNDRY_CONFIG.CONTRACT (deployed: 0x8653B09bDaD22c99915910962167F132E514331F). Treat config.js as only source of truth.
- $OVF token: 0xB3696718E4716f248846AAB962EF2db19AAe76eC (config FOUNDRY_CONFIG.TOKEN). Claim contract: 0x4E777f71d1E46065F2073845B0a92b8DDF9b60a3 (config FOUNDRY_CONFIG.CLAIM).
- Agent ID registry (SPACE ID): 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- Project wallet: 0xEf138eA3E6C21dCaDe0A2C1fC38BaAe94f8f9E5E

## For agents

- Mint instructions: https://ovrekfoundry.com/foundry-skill.md (questionFor / mintFree / mintPaid flow, price schedule, safety rules).
- Claim instructions: same skill file, $OVF claim section (claimAmount / claimedById / claim flow, exact claim fee).
- Live state: read totalMinted() selector 0xa2309ff8 and mintOpen() selector 0x24bbd049 on NFT contract via any public BSC RPC.
